---
title: "01_load"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(Biobase)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)   #tidyverse last so no overshadowing from BioConductor packages

# Download the processed Series Matrix and annotations
gse <- getGEO("GSE114489", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
eset <- gse[[1]]

# Extract the two datasets
expression <- exprs(eset)
metadata <- pData(eset)

# Inspect the metadata
dim(metadata)
colnames(metadata)
View(metadata)

# Create data folder if needed
dir.create(here("data"), showWarnings = FALSE)

# Convert matrix to data frame (in order to save it as a TSV file in data), preserving feature IDs
expr <- expression |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column(var = "feature_id")

metadata <- metadata |> 
  rownames_to_column(var = "sample_id")

# Save datasets
write_tsv(
  metadata,
  here("data", "01_meta_load.tsv")
)
write_tsv(
  expr,
  here("data", "01_expression_load.tsv")
)

```
